common_problems: Subcontractors paid without a conditional lien waiver, or with no unconditional waiver after the check cleared.
Invoices billed past the subcontract or PO value, or past the work the project manager approved.
Approved change orders never billed, and billing on changes that are not approved yet.
Job cost over or projected over budget, and cost charged to codes with no budget.
Insurance certificates expired, below your limits, or ending before the subcontractor's work does.
Certified payroll below the wage determination, or overtime not paid as overtime.
Retainage withheld at the wrong rate, or due to bill and not billed.
The same vendor or invoice entered twice, including invoices already paid twice.
reaches_the_model: When an assistant calls a tool, the agent reads your exported files on your computer and returns its result to the assistant: amounts, dates, job numbers, cost codes, company names (owners, subcontractors, suppliers) and its findings, in clear. Worker and technician names, worker ids, Social Security numbers, homeowner names and contacts, and your own staff named on records (project manager, superintendent, foreman, estimator) are replaced by stable pseudonyms first, also inside sentences and error messages. Text you typed into description or notes fields is sent as written, apart from those values and anything that looks like an SSN, e-mail address or phone number. Results go to whatever model your assistant uses; for sensitive records use a local model or one covered by your agreements. The report files written on your computer keep the real names.
rules_maintained: No wage rate, tax rate or insurance minimum is built in. Prevailing wage rates from the job's wage determination, union fringe rates, sales tax rates, insurance requirements, compliance document lists, surety limits and retainage rates are files and settings you keep next to your exports, and every result lists the values it used. The built-in defaults (overtime after 40 hours a week at 1.5 times the base rate, 10% retainage, 30-day notice and renewal windows) are settings too. When a rule changes you edit that file or setting; with support, we do it for you. The agents never fetch rules from the internet.
